spans.claim: Nick Stretton returns to La Chance mine and meets Paulette Brown
spans.anchor: I opened the shack door and went in,--and in the bare passage I jerked up taut
spans.span: I opened the shack door and went in,--and in the bare passage I jerked up taut.

spans.claim: Paulette Brown seals the gold boxes to prevent substitution
spans.anchor: On each box, just as I had expected even before I heard Paulette Brown say she had marked them, was a tiny seal in blue wax
spans.span: For on each box, just as I had expected even before I heard Paulette Brown say she had marked them, was a tiny seal in blue wax!

spans.claim: Wolf bait is used to lure wolves to attack Dudley Wilbraham
spans.anchor: That same wolf bait had been put in my wagon by somebody,--and the human cry out of the swamp at Paulette's shot suddenly repeated itself in my ears
spans.span: That same wolf bait had been put in my wagon by somebody,--and the human cry out of the swamp at Paulette's shot suddenly repeated itself in my ears.

spans.claim: Thompson's letter contains a hidden warning inside the envelope
spans.anchor: Take care, Macartney! Gold, life, everything--in danger!
spans.span: 'Take care, Macartney! Gold, life, everything--in danger!'" he read out blankly.

spans.claim: Macartney is revealed as Dick Hutton, the criminal mastermind
spans.anchor: For the written message on Thompson's lost card was plain. Macartney was--Hutton!
spans.span: CHAPTER XIII A DEAD MAN'S MESSENGER For the written message on Thompson's lost card was plain. Macartney was--Hutton! And Hutton's gang were just the new, rough men Macartney had dribbled in to the La Chance mine!

spans.claim: Four mill men are murdered in the assay office during a staged robbery
spans.anchor: They were decent men too, for they were the last of our own lot,--and it smote me like a hammer that they might have been alive still if I had not interfered with Paulette that night and kept her from meeting Hutton
spans.span: They were decent men too, for they were the last of our own lot,--and it smote me like a hammer that they might have been alive still if I had not interfered with Paulette that night and kept her from meeting Hutton.

spans.claim: Dunn and Collins are alive and hiding in secret tunnels
spans.anchor: I saw Dunn and Collins! Saw Dunn's stubbly fair hair, clipped close till it stood on end
spans.span: A match rasped, flared in my eyes, and I saw Dunn and Collins! Saw Dunn's stubbly fair hair, clipped close till it stood on end, as it had on the skull I'd said a prayer over and buried; saw Collins standing on the long shank bones I knew I had buried in the bush!

spans.claim: Macartney uses wolf dope and sabotage to control the mine
spans.anchor: I knew about Macartney's wolf dope business long ago, and do you suppose _this_

spans.claim: Paulette Brown is actually Tatiana Paulina Valenka
spans.anchor: The signature she wrote as plainly as I write it now was not Paulette Brown. It was Tatiana Paulina
spans.span: For the signature she wrote as plainly as I write it now was not Paulette Brown. It was Tatiana Paulina--that "queer Christian name, half Russian too," of the dancing circus-rider, that no one had ever mentioned,--_Tatiana Paulina Valenka_!

spans.claim: Macartney kills Dudley Wilbraham using wolf bait and ambush
spans.anchor: They got Mr. Wilbraham, and--they damn nearly got me!

spans.claim: Nick Stretton and allies use explosives to trap Macartney's gang
spans.anchor: I heard the fuse burn smooth as a dream, and Collins nudged me with fierce satisfaction

spans.claim: Macartney is killed after his crimes are exposed
spans.anchor: Macartney only stood there, looking so much as usual that I guessed he must have rested outside the mouth of our burrow before he wormed down to tackle me
spans.span: But Macartney only stood there, looking so much as usual that I guessed he must have rested outside the mouth of our burrow before he wormed down to tackle me.

spans.claim: Billy Jones is falsely accused of murder
spans.anchor: Not a day went by that three or four of them did not come for their time
spans.span: Not a day went by that three or four of them did not come for their time, chiefly rockmen and teamsters,--for we had no ore chute at La Chance.

spans.claim: Marcia Wilbraham betrays Paulette and helps Macartney
spans.anchor: Marcia flung herself on him as if she had only just realized him

spans.claim: Nick Stretton and Paulette escape across Lac Tremblant on snowshoes
spans.anchor: I led my dream girl out on it. I would have given half my life for a rope

spans.claim: Thompson's boy provides key testimony about the murder
spans.anchor: You? What's the matter with you? Brace up; it's only me!

spans.claim: Macartney's gang is defeated and the mine is saved
spans.anchor: An abandoned picket has a way of knowing when the game is up, and Macartney's men had cleared out on the double
spans.span: An abandoned picket has a way of knowing when the game is up, and Macartney's men had cleared out on the double, even before Charliet's first rifle bullet missed them.

spans.claim: Paulette and Nick Stretton confess their love
spans.anchor: I knew the dark hollows and the tear marks under her eyes were for Dudley, not for me
spans.span: I knew the dark hollows and the tear marks under her eyes were for Dudley, not for me.

spans.claim: Thompson's playing cards contain a secret message
spans.anchor: For God's sake search my cards--my cards--my cards
